# Turn a DistroKid earnings report into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Free DistroKid to QuickBooks and Xero journal converter: books music earnings by store (streaming, downloads, TikTok and YouTube) and sale month, songwriter royalties withheld as a deduction, checks row and report totals, and downloads a balanced journal for Xero, QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
